district: Shasta Tehama Joint Community College District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue up to $129,630,000 in general obligation bonds, repaid by a property tax, to construct and modernize college facilities and career-training programs.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes bond funding for expanded and improved community college facilities and services without increasing the stated property tax rate.
tax.quote: Bond Measure C will modernize 60-year-old buildings and facilities while expanding the college's ability to support public safety services for the region.

schools.text: A Yes vote funds construction and improvements at Shasta College, a district public school.
schools.quote: Projects would include new agriculture classrooms, expansion of the emergency medical services and certified nursing assistant labs and new public safety training facilities.

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the proposed bond funding for the college's facility and service improvements.
